instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. In a sunny outdoor park, a boy in a yellow t-shirt (R1) wearing glasses and a striped party hat joyfully hugs a girl in a light pink sweater (R6) from the right side. The girl in the pink sweater, wearing a white headband, smiles happily while holding two purple wrapped gifts in her arms. On the left, a girl in a dark blue top (R4) wearing a colorful party hat stands with her back partially turned to the camera, watching the two friends embrace. Bright, warm daylight illuminates the green trees and grass in the background, creating a cheerful atmosphere.
